title: Dell Seeks to Raise $4 Billion From Bond Sale to Refinance Debt
summary: Dell Technologies Inc. is seeking to raise about $4 billion from an investment-grade bond sale, joining a wave of issuers seeking to refinance debt as it rides an AI-driven boom in demand for servers.

title: MercadoLibre Returns to Global Debt Markets Amid Spending Push
summary: MercadoLibre Inc. is returning to global debt markets for only the third time as it boosts investment across Latin America.

title: Ledger Hires New Security Chief as Crypto Hacks Hit $1.4 Billion
summary: Ledger SAS, a maker of hardware devices used to store cryptocurrencies, is combining oversight of its internal technology systems and security under a single executive, as a rise in artificial intelligence-fueled crypto attacks pushes companies to rethink their defenses.

title: Amazon Gets £11.65 Billion of Bids for Debut Sterling Bond
summary: Amazon.com Inc. is expected to raise £4.25 billion ($5.8 billion) from its debut sterling bond sale, increasing the size of the four-part deal even as orders from investors eased slightly.

title: Franklin Templeton’s Johnson Says Cost of Capital to Slow Some Activities
summary: Jenny Johnson, president and CEO at Franklin Templeton Investments, discusses the rising cost of capital and the impact of the AI buildout on private credit and the US economy. Johnson speaks with Bloomberg’s Guy Johnson at the IPEM Global conference in Paris, France. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Top Drone Maker Sees Sales Surging Before Decision on Warsaw IPO
summary: WB Electronics SA expects revenue to surge in the coming years as Poland’s largest drone producer works toward a potential initial public offering in Warsaw.

title: Ares's Jacobson: Bifurcation in Software Market
summary: Blair Jacobson, Co-President of Ares Management, says investors need to be more careful in selection and due diligence in the software market. He speaks to Guy Johnson on "Bloomberg Brief" at the IPEM Global conference in Paris, France.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Legal AI Startup Harvey Hits $15.6 Billion Value With $550 Million Round
summary: Legal tech startup Harvey is now valued at $15.6 billion after raising $550 million in a new funding round aimed at powering efforts to build its own AI models.

title: Google Picks Finland for €13 Billion AI Data Center Buildout
summary: Alphabet Inc.’s Google is spending €13 billion ($15.1 billion) on artificial intelligence infrastructure in Finland, its biggest European investment, as the Nordic country’s cold climate and carbon-free power make it a magnet for data center builders.

title: UAE-Based Group Leads $1 Billion Satellite Project
summary: A consortium of companies, led by the UAE’s Marlan Space and US-French space startup Loft Orbital, plans to invest $1 billion as they add 40 satellites to an AI-infused constellation.

title: Google DeepMind Uses AI to Predict 9 Billion DNA Changes
summary: The lab hopes its model helps researchers find the secrets to ailments

title: New York’s Commercial Real Estate Market Gets Boost From AI
summary: The future still needs office space

title: Ares’ Jacobson Says AI Is Fueling a Software Industry Divide
summary: Blair Jacobson, co-president of Ares Management, discusses the outlook for the software industry which came under pressure earlier this year as investors weighed the impact of artificial intelligence on the sector. "The general view was all software will get eaten by AI," Jacobson tells Bloomberg's Guy Johnson from the sidelines of the IPEM conference in Paris. "Seven, eight, nine months later, we've actually seen a bifurcation in that market," he adds. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Lyft Begins Offering Waymo Robotaxi Rides on Its App in Nashville
summary: Lyft Inc. is starting to offer Waymo robotaxi rides in Nashville, marking the second US city where it’s providing driverless trips as it plays catch-up with rival Uber Technologies Inc.

title: China’s Huawei Comes to Brooklyn for Sweeping US Criminal Trial
summary: Huawei Technologies Co. is finally going to trial in New York in a criminal case brought during the first Trump administration that’s among the most ambitious prosecutions the US government has ever pursued against a Chinese company.

title: Nvidia-Backed Firm in Indonesia Signs $3.1 Billion GPU Loan
summary: Zankore, an Indonesian AI infrastructure platform backed by Nvidia Corp., signed a $3.1 billion loan deal on Wednesday to purchase advanced chips, underscoring surging demand for computing capacity across Asia.

title: AI Music Startup Suno Launches New Models That Pay Labels
summary: Suno Inc. is rolling out its long-awaited artificial intelligence models trained and made in cooperation with major music industry players, such as Warner Music Group Corp.

title: SoftBank to Repay $40 Billion Bridge Loan for OpenAI Stake
summary: SoftBank Group Corp. will repay the balance on a $40 billion loan it signed earlier this year to finance its investment in OpenAI, the Japanese conglomerate said Wednesday, as it moves ahead with plans to refinance that deal with longer-term debt.

title: Debut Offerings: Amazon Sterling Bonds; Uber Euro Bonds
summary: Amazon.com Inc. kicked off the sale of its debut sterling bonds in a four-part deal, as hyperscalers continue to turn to global debt markets to fuel the artificial intelligence arms race. Uber Technologies Inc. has started offering its debut euro bonds, with a five-part deal that is set to price later on Wednesday. Bloomberg's Anna Edwards and Tom Mackenzie have the details. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Paytm Bets on Workplace AI Agents in Pivot Beyond Payments
summary: Indian digital payments pioneer Paytm is expanding to a new business, jumping on the agentic AI bandwagon to accelerate a rebound in revenue growth.
